data.title: Letter from Santa Editable Printable, 6 Personalized Santa Letters, Nice List Certificate, North Pole Mail, Gift Tags
data.description:
Six letters from Santa for six different kinds of year, ready to type and print before Christmas Eve. Made for parents and grandparents of kids ages 2 to 9 who want a real North Pole letter without paying for a custom one or opening a Canva account.

Every letter is fully written and different. You type the child's name, the date, three good things they did this year and the P.S., then print. That is it.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (13 pages, US Letter, one editable PDF)
1. Cover with the full contents
2. How-to page: which letter fits which child, plus Christmas Eve delivery ideas
3. Letter 1, The Nice List: the classic letter for any child
4. Letter 2, Baby's First Christmas: a keepsake for a baby or toddler
5. Letter 3, New Big Sibling: for a child who became a big brother or sister this year
6. Letter 4, The Kindness Star: for a child who shared, helped or included others
7. Letter 5, A Hard Year, Done Well: for a move, a loss, an illness or a big change, handled bravely
8. Letter 6, A New Home: for a family that moved before Christmas
9. Official Nice List certificate with type-in name, elf note, signature and date
10. Santa's Nice List 2026: 14 type-in rows with "checked once" and "checked twice" tick boxes
11. Dear Santa wish list for the child: name, age, a kind thing they did, 6 wishes and a drawing box
12. 4 North Pole Express envelope labels with type-in name and address
13. 12 From Santa gift tags with type-in names
Plus a thank-you page at the end.

HOW EDITING WORKS
Open the PDF in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader on a computer (best), or the Adobe Acrobat Reader app on a phone or tablet. Click a pale green box and type. Sample words are already in every box, so you can keep them or type over them. No Canva account, no app sign-up, no waiting for an email. Fonts and colors are fixed so every page prints the way you see it. Other phone viewers may not show the type-in boxes.

PRINTING
Print at home at 100% on plain paper, or on cream or parchment cardstock for a real North Pole look. US Letter size; choose Fit to page for A4. Sign the letter in gold or red pen and seal it with a North Pole label.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
Nothing will be shipped. After you buy, go to You > Purchases on Etsy and tap Download Files. For personal use only.

data.title: Christmas Murder Mystery Party Game Printable for 8 Players, Family Friendly Whodunit Dinner Party Kit, Office Holiday Game
data.description:
A printable Christmas murder mystery party game written for exactly 8 players: a cozy whodunit for a Christmas dinner with friends, family or coworkers, no expansion pack to sort through. Print it, hand out the character sheets, and you are hosting a 2-hour mystery tonight.

THE STORY: The Stolen Star of Hollyridge Lodge. Christmas Eve, a snowed-in mountain lodge. At 7:08 every light goes out. At 7:20 they come back on and the lodge's famous gold Star is gone from the top of the tree. Eight guests, eight secrets, one thief. Family friendly: no violence, nothing is hurt but a mantel clock.

ONE FAIR ANSWER: the clues point to exactly one guest, and they prove it two separate ways (alibis and a shoe print). Every innocent guest has an alibi a clue card can confirm, so no one is left guessing and the reveal makes sense to the whole table. We checked the clue logic with code before release.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (16 pages, US Letter, prints on A4):
- Page 1: Cover with contents
- Page 2: Host guide (how it works, what to print, setup checklist, host tips)
- Page 3: Party timeline and host script (opening to read aloud, 3 rounds)
- Page 4: Invitations, 2 per sheet, fill in by hand
- Pages 5 to 12: 8 character sheets, one page each: who you are, costume idea, secret, alibi, what to say in Rounds 1, 2 and 3, and questions to ask
- Page 13: 9 clue cards, 3 per round, cut apart
- Page 14: Detective Notes accusation sheet, one per player
- Page 15: The solution, with a read-aloud reveal and who is cleared by which clue
- Page 16: 8 name tags and 2 awards (Master Detective, Best in Character)
Plus a thank-you page.

HOW TO HOST:
1. Send invitations 2 to 3 weeks ahead and give each guest a character.
2. A week before, send each guest only their own sheet.
3. On the night, read the opening, then read 3 clue cards each round. Dinner fits between Rounds 1 and 2.
4. Everyone fills in Detective Notes, then you read the sealed solution.
The host can play too. Fewer than 8 guests? The host guide says which pairs to drop.

THE CHARACTERS: Ivy (lodge owner), Jasper (ski instructor), Clem (head cook), Rupert (antique dealer), Noelle (lodge singer), Dash (handyman), Marigold (travel writer), Felix (owner's nephew). All original characters, any guest can play any role.

GOOD TO KNOW:
- Digital PDF download. Nothing ships. Download from your Etsy Purchases page after checkout, then print at home or at a print shop.
- Print in color or black and white.
- For personal use. Not editable; invitations have lines to fill in by hand.
- Best for adults and teens, about 2 hours.

MORE FOR THE SAME PARTY NIGHT: Christmas Party Games Bundle (8 printable games) and 36 Funny Christmas Party Awards Kit, both in the shop.

data.title: Christmas Escape Room for Kids Printable, Family Escape Room Game with 2 Levels Ages 6-9 and 10+, No Phone or QR Code, Classroom Party
data.description:
A printable Christmas escape room for kids and families, with two levels in one story: Level 1 for ages 6-9 and Level 2 for ages 10+. Big and little kids play the same game together, and you need no phone, app, QR code or internet to finish it.

THE STORY
It is Christmas Eve. Juniper, the youngest elf, locked the sleigh bells in the Bell Vault and forgot the 4-digit code. Players solve 4 clues, each clue gives one digit, and the 4 digits open the vault before the 45-minute timer runs out.

TWO LEVELS, SAME DIGIT
Every clue comes in two versions. Both versions lead to the same digit, so a 7-year-old and a 12-year-old can work side by side and check each other's answers.
- Clue 1: number code (Level 1) / shift cipher (Level 2)
- Clue 2: count the shelf (Level 1) / picture math (Level 2)
- Clue 3: tangled lights (Level 1) / bell maze (Level 2)
- Clue 4: 4x4 sudoku (Level 1) / elf logic grid (Level 2)

WHAT'S INCLUDED (16 pages, one PDF)
- Cover
- Game master guide: set-up in 10 minutes, how to run it, supplies
- Mission letter to read aloud, team sheet and code tracker
- 8 clue sheets (4 clues x 2 levels)
- Vault lock sheet (the final code)
- 6 envelope lock tags to cut out
- 8 hint cards, each with 2 fold-over hints
- Answer key with full solutions (game master only)
- Escape Expert certificates (2 per page)

GOOD TO KNOW
- Players: 1 to 12, in teams of 2 to 4. Play time about 45 minutes.
- No phone needed: the game master checks each digit with the answer key.
- Ink-light design: white pages with thin lines, and every puzzle works in black and white.
- Supplies: pencils, scissors, tape, 5 envelopes per team (or folded paper) and a timer.
- US Letter size; prints on A4 with "Fit to page".
- Good for Christmas break, family parties, classrooms and Christmas Eve.

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing is shipped. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy account (Purchases and reviews) or from the email Etsy sends you, then print at home or at a print shop. For personal and classroom use.
